recent_articles.title: Karachi Museum of History to be built by the seaside - Pakistan - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A groundbreaking ceremony was held at Clifton's Beach View Park for the Karachi Museum of History, a landmark cultural and educational space. **Sindh Chief Minister Syed Murad Ali Shah**, **Karachi Mayor Barrister Murtaza Wahab**, and representatives from the **Citizens Archive of Pakistan (CAP)** were among those present. The museum aims to preserve and celebrate Sindh's history and the Pakistan independence movement through storytelling, technology, archival material, and interactive experiences.  **Sharmeen Obaid-Chinoy**, CAP Patron-in-Chief, spearheaded the project, envisioning a space that honors Karachi's diverse heritage and resilience.

recent_articles.title: Kasaragod district administration prepares railway master plan to end travel hardships - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Kasaragod** district administration has proposed a comprehensive railway master plan to address travel hardships faced by passengers in the northern Kerala region. The proposals, submitted to **Palakkad Divisional Railway Manager (DRM) Madhukar Rawat**, include extending eight trains currently terminating at Kannur and Mangaluru Central/Junction to Kasaragod, as well as restoring discontinued passenger services. The administration also seeks stoppages for three major superfast trains that currently bypass Kasaragod station. These proposals aim to benefit passengers travelling for work, education, medical treatment, pilgrimage, and trade.  The district administration has requested the railway authorities to consider these proposals for improved convenience and efficient travel for residents of Kasaragod.

recent_articles.title: Telangana proceeds with plan to relocate polluting units outside city, issues HILTP norms - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Telangana** government has released implementation guidelines for the Hyderabad Industrial Lands Transformation Policy (HILTP). The policy aims to relocate polluting industries beyond the Outer Ring Road and convert vacant land into multi-use zones.  Eligible industrial units can submit applications through a dedicated online portal by June 30, 2026, receiving an upfront Development Impact Fee of 10% and consideration of existing market rates. **Telangana Industrial Infrastructure Corporation (TGIIC)** will oversee the policy's implementation.

recent_articles.title: Manipur CM assures NIA probe into abduction of Naga men - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Yumnam Khemchand Singh**, the Chief Minister of Manipur, promised an investigation by the **NIA** into the alleged abduction of six Naga men. The **Kuki Inpi Manipur** extended its shutdown for another 48 hours to pressure the government for the release of 14 Kuki people, including three minors.  The **UNC**, led by Ng. Lorho, urged the government to intensify efforts to find the missing villagers. The Chief Minister also assured the delegation that the abduction case would be handed over to the **NIA** and search-and-rescue operations were underway.

recent_articles.title: Uppal flyover works push traffic into residential lanes in eastern Hyderabad, double commute times for residents - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Traffic diversions** for the Uppal–Narapally elevated corridor project are causing significant congestion and delays in residential areas around Uppal X roads. **L. Niharika**, a commuter, reported heavy traffic even before peak office hours, while **Sai Nikhil**, an executive at a mobile phone store, noted a drop in walk-in customers due to the extended commute times.  Residents along diversion corridors are experiencing parking issues and increased travel times, impacting their daily lives. **G. Nagaraju**, Uppal Traffic Inspector, stated that although the diversions have helped prevent major bottlenecks on the main carriageway, they have shifted traffic onto residential roads not designed for sustained vehicular flow.

recent_articles.title: Public outcry grows louder over power cuts in U.P.; Oppn. parties call it structural failure - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Residents** of Uttar Pradesh are protesting frequent power cuts, exacerbated by the heat wave. **Opposition parties**, including the Samajwadi Party and Congress, have criticized the **Yogi Adityanath-led government** for its handling of the crisis, alleging a failure to expand power generation capacity and pointing to structural issues within the electricity department. The **Vidyut Karmchari Joint Sangharsh Samiti** has also blamed the vertical restructuring system implemented in the power corporation for the ongoing problems.

recent_articles.title: Govt. to soon bring in an AI policy to transform Bihar: CM - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary** announced the state government's intention to introduce an AI policy, aiming to transform Bihar into an AI hub.  He highlighted the potential of AI in India's communication revolution and emphasized the importance of collaboration with younger generations. The summit, organized by the IT Department in collaboration with the **Bihar Industries Association (BIA)** and Qlass EdTech, saw participation from Deputy Chief Minister **Bijendra Prasad Yadav**, Information Technology Minister **Nitish Mishra**, and founder of BharatGPT **Ankush Agrawal**.

recent_articles.title: Frequent disruption of ro-ro services give harrowing time to commuters - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Commuters and goods carriers** in the passenger-dense Fort Kochi-Vypeen corridor are experiencing difficulties due to frequent ferry service withdrawals. **The Kerala Shipping and Inland Navigation Corporation (KSINC)** operates the two ro-ro ferries, but demand for additional services is high.  **Kochi Corporation**, which owns the ferries, faces pressure from commuters and organizations like the Vypeen-Fort Kochi Passengers’ Association to address the issue. The association has urged **the Kochi Corporation** to prioritize ferry maintenance, stock spare parts, and expedite the construction of a third ro-ro ferry.

recent_articles.title: RTA suspends permits of 28 private buses - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Ernakulam Regional Transport Authority (RTA)** has suspended the permits of 28 private buses operating from various parts of the city to Kakkanad. The action follows a lightning strike in November 2025, during which the bus operators allegedly engaged in strikes without prior notice and left passengers stranded. **The Motor Vehicles department (MVD)** recommended permit suspension based on these violations.

recent_articles.title: Tension grips Malayidamthuruth amid intense protests - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Residents of the **Pariyathukavu** Dalit settlement in Kerala remained on high alert on Saturday, May 23rd, anticipating another attempt to evict them from their homes. Sathish, organized a protest meet, while various leaders visited the settlement to offer solidarity.

recent_articles.title: Unlike Centre, Sindh announces four Eid holidays - Pakistan - DAWN.COM

recent_articles.title: ‘Development is not about factories or roads; we must connect with people’ - The Hindu

recent_articles.title: Punjab govt bans activities 'injurious to public health, peace' ahead of Eidul Azha - Pakistan - DAWN.COM

recent_articles.title: Missing: Chennai’s new master plan - The Hindu

recent_articles.title: Floor leader Anchatageri defends resolution for creation of Greater HDMC - The Hindu

recent_articles.title: Hemant Soren launches self-enumeration phase of Census 2027 in Jharkhand - The Hindu

The process will continue until May 15th, with house-listing and housing census operations from May 16th to June 14th. **Prabhat Kumar**, Director of the Directorate of Census Operations (Government of India), also participated in the self-enumeration.  **Governor Santosh Kumar Gangwar** and **Aditya Sahu**, **BJP State president**, also recorded their details, highlighting the importance of census data for policymaking and development planning.

recent_articles.title: Mayor Murtaza Wahab believes it's 'improper' to compare Karachi and Lahore's governance - Pakistan - DAWN.COM

recent_articles.title: How Tamil Nadu waited for Assembly election results over the decades - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The 10-day waiting period between Tamil Nadu's Assembly election on April 23 and the counting of votes on May 4 is relatively short compared to past elections.  **DMK**, which won the 1967 Madras State Legislative Assembly election after a delimitation exercise, saw a longer wait for results. recent_articles.title: Punjab Assembly passes bill setting minimum marriage age at 18 for both males and females - Pakistan - DAWN.COM

The amendment also clarified that no child should be treated as an offender for being a contracting party to a child marriage and protected from coercion or manipulation.

The Department of Housing and Works terminated **Miller's** public housing tenancy due to non-compliance with property inspections, despite her application for a priority transfer pending approval.  The **Department of Communities**, which provided support services prior to her death, declined to comment on the specifics of her case.

recent_articles.title: Mumbai-Pune Missing Link project to be inaugurated on May 1 - The Hindu

recent_articles.title: Kallayi desilting project gathers pace, 45% of work completed - The Hindu

recent_articles.title: Woman killed by bear in Polish forest, son and local government say
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A 58-year-old woman was killed by a bear in the Bieszczady region of Poland while collecting antlers. Her son witnessed the attack and called for help, but emergency services were delayed due to difficult terrain and lack of phone reception. The incident is believed to have occurred near the town of Płonna, where **Poland** has around 100 brown bears.  The woman's death marks a rare fatal encounter between humans and bears in the country.

recent_articles.title: The Karur stampede is yet to fade from the memory of the voters at Velusamypuram - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Velusamypuram**, the site of a deadly political rally tragedy in September 2025, saw brisk polling on Thursday.  Voters were grappling with the lingering impact of the stampede that claimed 41 lives, including nine children, while awaiting answers about the cause and those responsible. **C. Joseph Vijay**, president of the **Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK)**, was accused in the case but voters largely refrained from discussing it during the election process.  The polling station at Velusamypuram recorded 81.31% turnout with almost four hours remaining before closing.

recent_articles.title: Business houses in Tamil Nadu pause for election - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article:
**Tamil Nadu** businesses largely shut down on election day, 2026, to allow employees to vote. The banking and real estate sectors were closed, while **Credai**, the Confederation of Real Estate Developers Associations of India, granted a full day leave for workers.  IT firms and industrial estates housing MSMEs saw varying degrees of closure, with essential businesses remaining operational. 
**Cognizant**, an IT firm, closed its offices in Tamil Nadu to enable employees to vote.

recent_articles.title: Pandalam family member criticises Kerala for stance in Sabarimala entry dispute - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A senior representative of the **Pandalam royal family**, who claims to be the foster family of Lord Ayyappa, argued before the Supreme Court on Thursday that the State of Kerala has not taken a strong stance against petitions questioning the age-old rituals and beliefs at the Sabarimala temple.  **K. Radhakrishnan**, representing the royal family, cited past instances where the state had failed to address similar demands for investigations into the Makaravilakku festival.

recent_articles.title: Tempers rise on second day of stir as Telangana RTC calls for temporary driver applications - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **TGSRTC** workers continued their strike on Thursday, with one worker attempting suicide in protest of delayed absorption into the government. **E. Venkanna**, chairman of the **RTC Joint Action Committee**, condemned the incident and demanded better treatment from the Telangana government. The committee also accused police of preventing peaceful protests and called for intervention by **Chief Minister A Revanth Reddy**.  The corporation ran all its hire buses and electric buses to maintain service, but this proved inadequate as they were unable to meet demand.

recent_articles.title: Residents near Katpadi boycott polls after relocation of polling booth - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Residents** of Balekuppam village in Vellore district boycotted elections on Thursday, protesting the relocation of a polling booth and lack of civic amenities. They hoisted black flags to signify their opposition and expressed dissatisfaction with the existing polling booth's distance from the village's Scheduled Caste settlement. The boycott was part of a wider movement against the proposed changes.

recent_articles.title: RTC driver succumbs after immolation bid, tension prevails in Warangal - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **K. Shankar Goud**, a 54-year-old driver for the **Telangana State Road Transport Corporation (TGSRTC)**, died from burn injuries sustained in an attempted self-immolation during the ongoing RTC employees' strike. The incident occurred at the Narsampet depot and prompted tension in the town and Warangal. Goud was rushed to a local hospital before being transferred to MGM Hospital in Warangal.

recent_articles.title: Troubled waters: A.P., T.N. fishermen embroiled in a row - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Fishermen** from **Cuddalore, Tamil Nadu**, and **Karaikal, Puducherry** released four mechanised boats seized by fishermen in **Nellore district, Andhra Pradesh**. The dispute over the boats, which have been at the center of a long-standing conflict between the two states for almost four decades, has fueled concerns about inadequate maritime patrols.

recent_articles.title: Telangana RTC strike | A transport system stuck in breakdown mode - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Telangana State Road Transport Corporation (TGSRTC)** has once again halted operations at its **Mahatma Gandhi Bus Station (MGBS)** due to a strike by its workers. The 32-demand strike, which began on April 22nd, is centered around the absorption of 40,000 employees into government service. This marks the second time in six years that public transport has been disrupted in **Telangana**, with the crisis persisting despite a change in political power.

recent_articles.title: Pahalgam, a year on: Resilience falters, tourism struggles - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The 2025 attack on the Baisaran meadow in Pahalgam, Kashmir, has significantly impacted tourism and livelihoods. The incident resulted in the closure of several tourist destinations, including Baisaran, Dabyan, and Chandanwari, leading to job losses for locals who relied on tourism-related businesses.  **The Jammu and Kashmir Cable Car Corporation (JKCCC)** is planning a cable car project connecting the meadow with the Yatri Niwas hotel to attract pilgrims during the Amarnath Yatra. Security measures have been intensified in Pahalgam, including facial recognition technology at tourist destinations. The attack has also led to a decline in tourism footfall and financial hardship for hotels and businesses that relied on the influx of visitors.  **Mehraj Din Wani**, an ATV owner, expressed concerns about the long-term impact on local livelihoods.

recent_articles.title: PM Shehbaz expresses displeasure at lack of functional early weather warning systems in GB - Pakistan - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif** expressed displeasure at the non-functional early weather warning system for glacial lake outburst floods (Glofs) in **Gilgit-Baltistan**, ordering an inquiry into its “non-functionality” and the "ineffective performance of relevant institutions."  He emphasized that public safety was paramount, directing federal agencies to cooperate with provinces on climate change policies. The meeting also addressed last year's flooding caused by illegal encroachments on river passages, with **Shehbaz** urging authorities to take proactive measures this monsoon season.

recent_articles.title: Fishers flag safety gaps, call for quick-response rescue service - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Fishermen** and **fishing boat owners** in Kozhikode have called on the **Fisheries department** to establish a disaster response unit. The action committee, citing the disruption of the Karunya marine ambulance service near the Beypore fishing harbour, demanded immediate intervention due to the lack of alternative arrangements for sea rescue operations following the ambulance's fitness issues.

recent_articles.title: Kancheepuram district sees over 87% polling - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Voting in the Kancheepuram district of Tamil Nadu was largely peaceful, with 87.39% voter turnout reported by 6 p.m.  **Siva** of Kuruvimalai in Orikkai attributed the high turnout to the DMK government's fulfillment of promises like pattas and good roads. **S. Ramesh**, an activist from Alancheri near Uthiramerur, highlighted the need for polling booths closer to villages due to poor road conditions.  Farmers at Keezh Kathirpur withdrew their protest after officials promised to expedite land document clearance.

recent_articles.title: Kerala fireworks tragedy: police search every inch as kin wait with bated breath - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Police** are continuing their search for missing persons in the aftermath of a devastating explosion at a fireworks unit in Mundathikode, **Kerala**.  The site has been cordoned off and officers have recovered severed body parts. A total of 14 people were killed in the blast, with five friends who went to check out the fireworks unit still missing. The search for the remaining victims is ongoing.
